_comment_sizing: Lambda CPU scales with memory, so 1024MB roughly halves image resize time
at near-identical cost. The 120s timeout only benefits the asynchronous
derivative task - HTTP requests are still capped at 29s by API Gateway.
_comment_vpc: Empty, and the key stays. Zappa only sends VpcConfig when the key is
present, so deleting it would leave the deployed function attached to the
old subnets with nothing in the template saying so. Empty lists are what
Order on the real deploy: `zappa update production`, confirm with
`aws lambda get-function-configuration` that VpcConfig is empty, then
detach AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole and wait 20-40 minutes for the ENIs
to release before the subnets can go. See docs/INFRA.md.
_comment_env: Pool and client ids are not secrets, so they live here rather than in the
remote env file. Only COGNITO_STAFF_CLIENT_SECRET and DJANGO_SECRET_KEY
are, and those still come through remote_env from SSM by hand. Fill these
in from the dakkamotors-data stack outputs before the first deploy.
_comment_roles: Zappa rewrites its execution role's inline policy on every deploy, which
would force the CI role to carry broad IAM write permissions. The role
already exists, so leave it alone and just pass it.
_comment_exclude: Patterns are matched against directory names anywhere in the package, so a
bare entry like 'staticfiles' also deletes django/contrib/staticfiles and the
Lambda fails to import at start-up. Keep these anchored to real paths.
